Name: Adjustable Sprinklers
Author: ncarigon
Description:
I really dislike normal sprinklers. This mod allows you to specify the watering radius of a normal sprinkler and it will scale each sprinkler tier by the specified increase, with a nozzle increasing the tier by one level further.

To somewhat mitigate the unbalanced nature of increasing sprinkler radius, I also made it possible to use a circular watering area instead of the normal square area.

You can also show the tiles to be watered during placement. I threw in scarecrow active tiles during placement as well.

Lastly, you can manually activate a sprinkler by clicking on it.

[b]*NEW*[/b] You can now water garden pots, slime hutch troughs, and pet bowls using sprinklers, configurable with an option for each.

Other mods already exist which do this, and sometime more, but I found they did so in ways that were too different from the normal game logic and would cause compatibility issues. This mod should be highly compatible, and has specifically been tested with the following:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21608]Garden Pot Options[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21608][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools Continued[/url]
[/list]
[u]Configuration[/u]
Default game:
[list]
[*]Starting Radius = 0
[*]Tier Increase = 1
[*]Square Area
[/list]
Default mod:
[list]
[*]Starting Radius = 1
[*]Tier Increase = 1
[*]Circular Area
[/list]
[u]Watering Tiles Comparisons[/u]
Default game:
[list]
[*]Normal = 4
[*]Quality = 8
[*]Iridium = 24
[*]Iridium+Nozzle = 48
[/list]
Default mod:
[list]
[*]Normal = 8
[*]Quality = 21
[*]Iridium = 36
[*]Iridium+Nozzle = 68
[/list]
